MemeDef.label: militarist
MemeDef.description: War is the highest calling. Our people train for battle, honor those who bear arms, and settle disputes with steel. Unlocks the gladiator duel and military parade rituals.

rulesStrings.li: creation(tag=meme_CM_Militarist) ->[deity0_name] was born on a battlefield, and the first sound [deity0_pronoun] heard was the clash of steel.
episode(uses=1,tag=meme_CM_Militarist) ->[deity0_name] gathered the bravest of the [memberNamePlural] and drilled them until they moved as one, and no enemy could stand before them.
intro(tag=meme_CM_Militarist) ->The [place_summary] [place_name] was a garrison town, and [deity0_name] was the patron of its soldiers.
conflict(tag=meme_CM_Militarist) ->A [foeLeader] disbanded the garrison of [place_name] and left its people defenseless.
founderJoin(tag=meme_CM_Militarist) ->A veteran named [founderName] gathered the disbanded soldiers and swore them to [deity0_name].
victory(tag=meme_CM_Militarist) ->[founderName]'s army marched on the [foeLeader] and broke the [foeSoldiers] in a single battle.
setup(tag=meme_CM_Militarist) ->[founderName] served in a dozen wars, and saw that only the disciplined survive.
story(uses=1,tag=meme_CM_Militarist) ->When raiders struck [founder_possessive] village, [founderName] alone stood firm, and the others rallied around [founder_objective].
lessonIntro(tag=meme_CM_Militarist) ->An old sergeant once told me
lesson(tag=meme_CM_Militarist) ->peace is only the time between wars
lesson(tag=meme_CM_Militarist) ->a people who will not fight will not last
lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_CM_Militarist) ->So keep your weapon clean and your ranks tight.
archistBasis(tag=meme_CM_Militarist) ->The archotechs were forged in humanity's wars, and they respect only strength.
archistFact(tag=meme_CM_Militarist) ->The archotechs wage wars beyond our sight, and they choose champions among those who fight well.
archistProphecy(tag=meme_CM_Militarist) ->[inTheEnd], an army of [memberNamePlural] bearing the relic [relic0_name] will win the last war.
animistFact(tag=meme_CM_Militarist) ->The spirits of fallen warriors live on in their weapons, and lend their strength to those who wield them.
animistProphecy(tag=meme_CM_Militarist) ->When the last battle is fought, every warrior spirit will rise to stand with the victors.
